overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed the Fiscal Year 2027 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan, which proposes allocating approximately $1.733 million in federal funds. Representatives from city departments and non-profit partners presented funding requests for housing assistance, elder services, food security, and multilingual mental health programs.

items.title: CDBG Action Plan Overview
items.summary: Grants Manager Laurel Siegel presented the $1.433 million allocation for Program Year 52, which includes funding for administration, public services, and infrastructure projects.

items.title: ABCD Housing and Fuel Assistance
items.summary: Joshua White described programs for rental arrears and financial literacy, noting that the fuel assistance application period ends on April 30.

items.title: Housing Families Legal Services
items.summary: Jayna Stafford outlined the legal aid program that provides eviction prevention and financial advocacy for Medford families facing housing instability.

items.title: Council on Aging Services
items.summary: Director Pam Kelly detailed the use of funds for social work outreach, a handyman program for home safety, and subsidized recreational transportation for seniors.

items.title: Medford Public Schools After-School Scholarships
items.summary: The committee reviewed a proposal to provide tuition assistance for up to 20 low-income families requiring after-school care.

items.title: Mystic Valley Elder Services Nutrition Program
items.summary: Carla Madute requested support for Meals on Wheels and congregate dining programs to help offset a 30% reduction in federal nutrition funding.

items.title: Mystic Community Market Food Security
items.summary: The committee heard a presentation on the market's food distribution efforts, which served nearly 5,000 residents and distributed 1.5 million pounds of food last year.

items.title: RISE Multicultural Mental Health Support
items.summary: Monica presented a new proposal for multilingual mental health support circles designed to reduce isolation and emotional distress among immigrant seniors.

items.title: SCM Community Transport
items.summary: John Keegan discussed door-to-door medical and social transportation services, including new shuttles to Target and Walmart funded by external grants.

items.title: The Welcome Project ESOL Program
items.summary: Mary Beauchard and Suwani Lima explained the English for Parents program that helps immigrant caregivers build language skills to navigate the school system.

items.title: Plan Review and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee referred the plan to the May 12 regular meeting for a final vote following the close of the public comment period.

subject: FY 2027 CDBG Annual Action Plan
